name: UJOY3D / UJOYBIO
summary: Shenzhen-linked budget Amazon brand family selling PLA+, high-speed and metallic PETG, Hyper PLA and Elite PLA+ in 4- and 10-packs at about $7.50-10.50/kg, plus filament dryers and 3D-pen filament. The UJOY3D and UJOYBIO names share marketing and listings, but their USPTO records name different owners.

product_lines.name: PLA+ Standard
product_lines.notes: 1 kg in 4- and 10-packs; 8/16 x 250 g bundles.

product_lines.name: Metallic PLA Plus
product_lines.notes: Per web listings; metallic look, no metal-fill evidence.

additional_notes: Store is Amazon US; sites ujoybio.com / ujoybio3d.com were not reached. Two trademark filers: Yuanjia Biotechnology (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. for UJOY3D and Shenzhen Chensi Trading Co., Ltd for UJOYBIO; the marketing (Bambu Lab forum account 'UJOYBIO3D_Printer_Fi', linktr.ee/ujoybio) treats them as one brand. A seller listing self-claims the company is a PLA pellet manufacturer (unverified), so manufacturing_countries is omitted. Trustpilot reviews are mixed. No relationship to any catalog extruder found.

provenance.conflicts: Justia records read 2026-11-06: UJOY3D (serial 98222774, filed 2023-10-13, Class 17 filament) is owned by Yuanjia Biotechnology (Guangdong) Co., Ltd., Futian, Shenzhen; UJOYBIO (serial 98589271, filed 2024-06-06, Class 17 filament) by Shenzhen Chensi Trading Co., Ltd, Qianhai, Shenzhen. Justia shows both at the initial '630 New Application' event only, so the earlier 'live' / 'dead' statuses are unsupported (TSDR returned 500). Two legal entities, one marketing family.
